English: At the start of each turn, deal &a damage to all allies (33% of Attack).
Chinese: 每个回合开始时，对所有队友造成 &a 伤害(攻击力的33%)。

English: Targets self instead. Removes after triggering.
Chinese: 攻击改为指向自己。触发后移除。

English:
Attacks have a &a% chance to fail.
Removes after triggering.
Chinese:
攻击有 &a% 概率失效。
触发后移除。

English: When resolving, for each stack of?Pain?on self, increase this debuff's damage per turn by 1.
Chinese: 结算时，自身每有 1 层痛苦减益，使这个减益增加 1 点每回合伤害。

English: Blocks CC or Weaken debuffs that allies fail to resist. After triggering, or after taking &a damage (50% of &user's Defense), loses 1 stack.
Chinese: 抵挡友军未能抵抗的干扰减益或弱化减益。触发后，或受到&a点伤害(&user防御力的50%)后减少 1 层。

English:
At the end of the turn, heal &a HP (50% of &user's Defense) and remove 1 stack.
When taking damage, gain &a Barrier (50% of &user's Defense) and remove 1 stack.
Chinese:
回合结束时恢复 &a 点体力值(&user防御力的50%)，并减少 1 层。
受到伤害时生成 &a 保护罩(&user防御力的50%)，并减少 1 层。

English: Increases card draws per turn by 1 for this battle.
Chinese: 本次战斗期间每回合抽牌次数增加1点。

English: Increases max Mana by 1 for this battle.
Chinese: 本次战斗期间最大法力值增加1点。

English:
Links to the nearest unit (prioritizes rightward search).
When hit by a single-target skill, repeats the skill once on the linked target.
Chinese:
与距离最近的单位链接（优先向右寻找）；
受到单体技能时，会同时对链接目标重复释放 1 次。

English: Dies immediately if HP falls below 13%.
Chinese: 体力值低于13%时立即死亡。

English: Reduce Damage Taken by &a% (50% of &user's Defense), remove 1 stack after trigger.
Chinese: 使受到的伤害降低 &a% (&user防御力的50%)，触发后减少 1 层。

English:
Permanently active.
At 5 stacks, grants an additional 100% Crit Rate.
Chinese:
永久有效
到达 5 层时，额外提升100%暴击率。

English: When pressing the End Turn button, gains "Veil of the Moon."
Chinese: 按下回合结束按钮时，获得“月之面纱”。
使用自己的技能时解除。

English:
Resets cooldown when casting Elemental Invocation.
Loses 1 stack after triggering.
Chinese:
释放「元素祈唤」时重置冷却时间。
触发后减少 1 层。

Current Element Levels:
Metal - &a
Wood - &b
Water - &c
Fire - &d
Earth - &e
Sun - &f
Moon - &g
Chinese:
当前元素等级：
金 - &a
木 - &b

English: It's such a pain in the ass to get out and stuff ...... Forget it, just this once ......
Chinese: 出门什么的好麻烦……算了，只此一次……

English: Knowledge and Reclusive Maiden - At the start of battle, exile all own Elemental skills for this battle. Each exiled Elemental skill is converted into an Elemental attribute. Repeated conversions increase the attribute's level. Ability to Use Magic - Fixed ability replaced with Elemental Invocation. At Level 3, the first cast of Elemental Invocation per turn resets its cooldown. At Level 5, the reset count increases to 2 per turn. - This passive activates from Level 1. - Patchouli's normal skill learning no longer has a cap.
Chinese: 知识与避世的少女 - 战斗开始时，在本次战斗期间放逐自己的所有“元素”技能。每个被放逐的“元素”技能会转化为“元素”属性，重复转化的“元素”属性会提升属性的等级。 使用魔法程度的能力 - 固定能力替换为「元素祈唤」。 等级到达3级时，每个回合第 1 次释放「元素祈唤」后，重置「元素祈唤」的冷却时间。 等级到达5级时，每回合重置次数提升至 2 次。 - 此被动从1级开始生效。 - 帕秋莉的普通技能学习不再拥有上限。

English:
Patchouli Knowledge is an all-round witch, capable of excelling in offense, healing, support, debuffing, and protection.

By studying different "Basic Elements," Patchouli gains corresponding attribute values. In battle, she can freely combine these elements to construct a vast network of skills, allowing her to effortlessly adapt to any situation. The "Advanced Elements" learned through the "Golden Skillbook" can even create dazzling and diverse new skills.

Bow before the genius of the Sevenfold Star Witch!
Chinese:
帕秋莉·诺蕾姬是全才全能的魔女，不论是进攻、治疗、辅助、削弱或是保护都能胜任。

通过学习不同的“基础元素”，帕秋莉能够获得与之相应的属性值。在战斗中，帕秋莉还能够自由组合这些元素，构筑出庞大的技能网络。无论是面对什么样的情况，都能使用相符的技能轻松应对。通过“黄金技能书”学习的“高级元素”，更是能创造绚烂多样的全新技能。

拜倒在七曜大魔女的才华之下吧！

English: "The Seven Luminaries and Five Elements all heed my command!"
"What spell should I use to defeat them…?"
Chinese: 用什么法术打败他们好呢……
拜倒在我的魔法之下吧。
你也化作元素的一部分吧。

English: "Excuse me, could you not disturb me?"
Chinese: 不好意思，能别打扰我吗？
财宝……魔理沙说不定会很喜欢吧。

English: "If there's nothing else, may I go back…? No? Why?"
Chinese: 没事的话，我可以回去吗……？不行？为什么？

English: "Cough, cough… It's nothing, just an old ailment acting up…"
Chinese: 咳咳咳……没什么，只是老毛病犯了……

English: "Lucy, traveling this far with you has been pleasant. Heh, let a witch do what a witch must."
Chinese: 露西，和你一起旅行到这里很愉快。呵呵，就让魔女做魔女该做的事吧。

English: "Mind control? You don’t actually think that would work on me………………"
Chinese: 心灵控制？你不会觉得这东西对我有……………………

English: "You call yourself a witch too? How laughable—can just anyone be a witch these days?"
Chinese: 你也自称是魔女？真是可笑，现在什么人都能做魔女了吗？

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#FFD700>Control</color>.
When used, increases <color=#FFD700>Metal</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#FFD700>Metal</color> grants 5% Weaken Success, CC Success, Weaken Resist, and CC Resist.
Chinese:
象征<color=#FFD700>控制</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#FFD700>金</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#FFD700>金</color>提供5%弱化成功率、干扰成功率和弱化抵抗率、干扰抵抗率。

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#228B22>Persistence</color>.
When used, increases <color=#228B22>Wood</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#228B22>Wood</color> grants 5% Pain Success and Pain Resist.
Chinese:
象征<color=#228B22>持续</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#228B22>木</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#228B22>木</color>提供5%痛苦成功率和痛苦抵抗率。

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#00BFFF>Healing</color>.
When used, increases <color=#00BFFF>Water</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#00BFFF>Water</color> grants 1 Healing Power and 1% Evasion.
Chinese:
象征<color=#00BFFF>治疗</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#00BFFF>水</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#00BFFF>水</color>提供1点治疗力、1%闪避率。

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#FF4500>Offense</color>.
When used, increases <color=#FF4500>Fire</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#FF4500>Fire</color> grants 1 Attack and 1% Crit Rate.
Chinese:
象征<color=#FF4500>进攻</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#FF4500>火</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#FF4500>火</color>提供1点攻击力、1%暴击率。

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#8B7355>Protection</color>.
When used, increases <color=#8B7355>Earth</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#8B7355>Earth</color> grants 4% Defense.
Chinese:
象征<color=#8B7355>保护</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#8B7355>土</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#8B7355>土</color>提供4%防御力。

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#FFA500>Wealth</color>.
When used, increases <color=#FFA500>Sun</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#FFA500>Sun</color> grants 50% Critical Damage.
Chinese:
象征<color=#FFA500>财富</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#FFA500>日</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#FFA500>日</color>提供50%暴击伤害。

English:
Symbolizes the authority of <color=#6A5ACD>Authority</color>.
When used, increases <color=#6A5ACD>Moon</color> element level by 1 for this battle.
Each level of <color=#6A5ACD>Moon</color> grants 20% Damage Taken Reduce.
Chinese:
象征<color=#6A5ACD>权力</color>的权能。
使用时，在本次战斗期间<color=#6A5ACD>月</color>元素等级提升 1 级。
每个等级的<color=#6A5ACD>月</color>提供20%受到伤害量降低。

English:
At the start of battle, placed at the top of the deck.
Draw 1 skill. Gain 1 level each of <color=#FFD700>Metal</color>, <color=#228B22>Wood</color>, <color=#00BFFF>Water</color>, <color=#FF4500>Fire</color>, and <color=#8B7355>Earth</color>.
Chinese:
战斗开始时，放在牌库最上方。
抽取 1 个技能。获得<color=#FFD700>金</color>、<color=#228B22>木</color>、<color=#00BFFF>水</color>、<color=#FF4500>火</color>、<color=#8B7355>土</color>每种元素各 1 级。

English:
Draw 2 skills.
Reveal all exiled Basic Element skills, choose 1, and create a copy in hand.
Reveal all exiled Magic Book skills, choose 1, and create a copy in hand.
Chinese:
抽取 2 个技能。
展示放逐牌库中所有“基本元素”技能，选择其中 1 个，在手中生成其复制。
展示放逐牌库中所有“魔法书”技能，选择其中 1 个，在手中生成其复制。

English:
Select 2?Elemental?attributes from the exiled deck, combine them, and obtain the corresponding Spell Card skill.
Spell Card skills created by combining "Advanced Elements" can only be formed once per battle.
Chinese:
从放逐牌库中选择2种“元素”属性，将其组合后获得对应的符卡技能。
使用“高级元素”组合出来的符卡技能，每场战斗仅限组合 1 次。

English: Each level of?Metal?applies an additional stack of?Metal Fatigue.
Chinese: 每个等级的“金”额外施加 1 层“金属疲劳”。

English:
Each level of Metal applies an additional stack of Elemental Anomaly and Elemental Disorder.
Each level of Wood applies an additional stack of Elemental Entanglement.
Chinese:
每个等级的“金”额外施加1层“元素异常”和“元素紊乱”。
每个等级的“木”额外施加1层“元素纠缠”。

English:
Each level of Water heals an additional &a HP (10% of Healing Power).
Each level of Metal applies an additional stack of Life Surge.
Chinese:
每个等级的“水”使这个技能额外治疗&a点体力(治疗力的10%)。
每个等级的“金”额外施加1层“生命涌现”。

English:
Each level of Fire deals an additional &a damage (10% of Attack).
Each level of Metal applies an additional stack of Metal Fatigue.
Chinese:
每个等级的“火”使这个技能额外造成&a点伤害(攻击力的10%)。
每个等级的“金”额外施加1层“金属疲劳”。

English:
Apply &a Barrier (50% of Defense).

Each level of Metal applies an additional stack of Stone Guardian.
Each level of Earth grants an additional &b Barrier (10% of Defense).
Chinese:
施加 &a 点保护罩(防御力的50%)。

每个等级的“金”额外施加1层“巨石护卫”。
每个等级的“土”额外施加&b点保护罩(防御力的10%)。
在场上召唤 1 个地狱火。

English:
Transforms the target into a harmless small animal.
If the target is an ally, also dispels all debuffs and restores 2 Mana.
If the target is a Boss, stuns for 1 turn instead.
Chinese:
将目标变为一只人畜无害的小动物。
若目标是友军，还会驱散所有减益效果，且恢复 2 点法力值。
若目标是Boss，则改为眩晕 1 回合。

English:
Spreads all Pain debuffs on the target to other enemies.

Each level of Wood applies an additional stack of Forest Wildfire.
Chinese:
使目标持有的所有痛苦减益扩散至其他敌人。

每个等级的“木”额外施加1层“森林大火”。

English:
When cast, also targets the unit to the right.

Each level of Water heals an additional &a HP (10% of Healing Power).
Each level of Wood applies an additional stack of Living Water Essence.
Chinese:
释放时，同时对目标右边的角色释放。

每个等级的“水”使这个技能额外治疗&a点体力(治疗力的10%)。
每个等级的“木”额外施加1层“活水之精”。

English:
When cast, deals Pain damage to all enemies equal to the per-turn damage of debuffs they hold.

Each level of Fire deals an additional &a damage (10% of Attack).
Each level of Wood applies an additional stack of Forest Wildfire.
Chinese:
释放时对所有敌人造成痛苦伤害，伤害量等于目标持有的减益的每回合伤害量。

每个等级的“火”使这个技能额外造成&a点伤害(攻击力的10%)。
每个等级的“木”额外施加1层“森林大火”。

English:
Each level of Wood increases Living Armor's Defense bonus by 4%.
Each level of Earth increases Living Armor's healing and Barrier by &a (10% of Defense).
Chinese:
每个等级的“木”使“活体护甲”的防御力提升额外增加4%。
每个等级的“土”使“活体护甲”的治疗和保护罩提升 &a (防御力的10%)。

English: Increases card draws per turn by 1 for this battle.
Chinese: 本次战斗期间每回合抽牌次数增加 1 点。

English: Increases max Mana by 1 for this battle.
Chinese: 本次战斗期间最大法力值增加 1 点。

English:
If the target cannot be healed, instead increases their HP by &a (130% of Healing Power).

Each level of Water heals or increases HP by an additional &b (20% of Healing Power).
Chinese:
如果目标无法受到治疗，则改为使目标的生命值提升 &a 点(治疗力的130%)。

每个等级的“水”使这个技能额外治疗或提升&b点体力(治疗力的20%)。

English:
Repeats 1 times. If you have 3 levels of Fire and Water, then repeats 2 extra times.
Each cast heals the ally with the lowest HP by &a (45% of Healing Power).

Each level of Fire deals an additional &b damage (5% of Attack). 
Each level of Water heals an additional &d HP (5% of Healing Power).
Chinese:
重复释放 1 次。如果同时拥有3级的“火”和“水”，额外重复释放 2 次。
每次释放时，恢复体力值最低的友军 &a 点体力值(治疗力的45%)。

每个等级的“火”使这个技能额外造成&b点伤害(攻击力的5%)。
每个等级的“水”使这个技能额外治疗&c点体力(治疗力的5%)。

English:
Randomly dispels 1 debuff on the target. For each debuff dispelled, applies &a Barrier (10% of Healing Power).

Each level of Water heals an additional &a HP (10% of Healing Power).
Each level of Earth dispels 1 additional debuff.
Chinese:
随机解除目标持有的 1 个减益效果。每解除 1 个减益效果，施加 &a 保护罩(治疗力的10%)。

每个等级的“水”使这个技能额外治疗&a点体力(治疗力的10%)。
每个等级的“土”额外解除 1 个减益效果。

English:
This skill's countdown does not trigger when pressing the End Turn button.
During countdown, whenever an Investigator takes damage, records the damage, reduces this skill's healing by that amount, and immediately heals the target by the same amount. Releases when healing falls below 0.
Chinese:
这个技能的倒计时不会因为按下回合结束按钮而释放。
倒计时期间，当任意调查员受到伤害时，记录伤害量，降低这个技能等量的治疗量，立即治疗目标等量的体力值。这个技能的治疗量低于0时立即释放。

English:
This skill ignores Defense.

Each level of Fire deals an additional &a damage (20% of Attack).
Chinese:
这个技能无视防御。

每个等级的“火”使这个技能额外造成&a点伤害(攻击力的20%)。

English:
Attacks all enemies with the same Taunt status as the target.
Converts 15% of damage dealt into a Barrier for self.

Each level of Fire deals an additional &a damage (10% of Attack).
Each level of Earth increases Shield conversion by 10%.
Chinese:
同时攻击与技能目标嘲讽状态相同的所有敌人。
造成伤害的15%转化为自身的保护罩。

每个等级的“火”使这个技能额外造成&a点伤害(攻击力的10%)。
每个等级的“土”使保护罩转化倍率提升10%。

English:
When killing an enemy, draws 1 skill and permanently increases this skill's damage by 1.1x.
Current triggers: &a
Current multiplier: &b
Current damage: &c
Chinese:
击杀敌人时，抽取 1 个技能，并使这个技能造成的伤害永久提升 1.1 倍。
当前触发次数：&a
当前提升倍数：&b
当前伤害数值：&c

English: Attacks all enemies with the same Taunt status as the target.
Chinese: 同时攻击与技能目标嘲讽状态相同的所有敌人。

English: Each level of Earth applies an additional stack of Stone's Reputation.
Chinese: 每个等级的“土”额外施加1层“石至名归”。

English: Reduces the cost of skills in hand by 1 each time they are used.
Chinese: 每次使用手中的技能时减少 1 点费用。

English:
Repeats this skill based on the number of times own skills in hand have been used this battle.
Current count: &a
Chinese:
根据这场战斗中自身使用过手中的技能的次数，重复释放这个技能。
当前次数：&a

English:
Returns 1 own skill from the exiled deck to hand.
Resets all Advanced Element Spell Card combination counts.
Chinese:
从放逐牌库中将 1 个自己的技能拿回手中。
重置所有“高级元素”符卡的可组合次数。

English: Reveal all exiled Basic Element skills, choose 1, and create a copy in hand.
Chinese: 展示放逐牌库中所有“基本元素”技能，选择其中 1 个，在手中生成其复制。
